target.name: Griffin Capital-Benefit Street Partners BDC Corp.

listed_quote.quote: The Griffin Credit Fund is an “interval fund” that has adopted a fundamental policy to make quarterly repurchase offers at NAV (less any repurchase fee) for no less than 5% of its outstanding shares.

announcement.quote: This is a brief overview of the reorganization proposed for Griffin Capital-Benefit Street Partners BDC Corp. (the “Company”) and Griffin Institutional Access Credit Fund (the “Griffin Credit Fund”).

deals.notes: Acquirer is an interval fund, so not a listed pair. The target BDC was renamed Griffin-Benefit Street Partners BDC Corp. (July 2017) and then Griffin Capital BDC Corp. (July 31, 2017). The 2017-09-15 425 says the special meeting was adjourned to September 18, 2017 and that stockholders had 'voted significantly in favor of each proposal'; no excerpt states the final outcome.
